title: one row of data/<runid>/questions.jsonl
description: The contract between the generator, the runner and the scorer. Every field is decided by the generator BEFORE any model sees the question; nothing here may be edited after a run.

id.description: stable item id, used as the transcript filename

question.description: sent verbatim as the sole user message in every arm

truth.description: scalar for a scalar type, array for list<T>; derived from the pinned-block response, never from a model

form.description: P = the canonical phrasing that became a training row. E1/E2 = held-out phrasings, never trained. Headline accuracy is E1+E2 only.

taught.description: false = held-out fact. Arm C must fail these; if it does not, the run is void.

hop.description: 1 = single fact, 2 = join of two facts computed by the generator

query_hash.description: sha256 of the GraphQL query text

block.description: B* — the pinned block every query was re-issued at

json_path.description: path into the committed raw response the truth was read from

source_ids.description: Every deployment a fair query could have targeted for this item. hop 1: the fact's own deployment. hop 2: the deployments of ALL operand facts — reaching for either side of a join or a comparison is legitimate work, so `wrong_subgraph` is 'no executed query targeted ANY of these', never a comparison against `source.deployment_id` alone.

ood_tier.description: Set ONLY on rows of data/<runid>/questions-fresh.jsonl (pipeline/ood.mjs). Names how far the item sits from the 120 facts the patch was baked from. Absent on every row of questions.jsonl.

ood_stability.description: Whether this item's truth was re-read identically from the SECOND committed pull. Arm B queries the live head, so a truth that moves would score arm B wrong for being right about now.

answer_atom_in_trainset.description: Truth atoms that also appear as a trainset answer (e.g. WETH). Recorded, never filtered: removing them would delete exactly the items arm C might get right by accident, which flatters our own thesis.

moved.description: fresh tier only: whether the fact did not exist at B*, or existed and changed beyond the scorer's tolerance.

was.description: fresh tier only: the value at B*, or null for a fact that did not exist then.

subject_is_trained_entity.description: unseen_relation tier only: the entity IS one the patch saw, so the only unseen thing is the relation.

trained_sibling_relation.description: unseen_relation tier only: the relation the patch DOES hold for this same entity.

fresh.description: legacy marker written by pipeline/questions.mjs's fresh path.

n_candidates.description: vault_top_by_tvl only: how many vaults the generator ranked.

fresh_supersedes_trained_fact.description: fresh tier only: this fact IS one of the 120 the patch was trained on, and its value has since moved. The patch now holds a stale answer — the most informative item in the bucket, and the reason the fresh tier is exempt from the coverage checks D1-D3.

fresh_supersedes_study_item.description: fresh tier only: the 250-item study asks about this same fact at B*. The two items share a question string and carry different truths, by design; they live in different runs and different files.
